name: Chalcolithic Europe
short_desc: Copper working and more unequal social structures spread through parts of prehistoric Europe.
date_note: Very approximate regional bounds, about 5000–2000 BCE. The transition from Neolithic to Copper and Bronze Age practices occurred at different times in different European regions; these are not universal boundaries.
notes: New source-linked entry. The Wikipedia introduction, date evidence and article identity received an initial editorial check; independent claim-specific source review remains open.
